title: 第072章 室女宗宗主闭关日第071章 策反计划
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：全民修仙之系统上交囯家正文第072章：室女宗宗主闭关日（..la）大长老坐在灯下，那只手仍然保持着翻开的姿态。烛火在他身边跳动着，把他投在墙壁上的影子拉长了大约一寸。他坐在那里，听着脚步声沿着台阶一层一层地往下走，越来越轻，越来越远。最后一声脚步声在塔底消失了。
窗外风从室女宗主星的方向灌进来。那枚搁在桌上的笔被风吹动了一下，又停住了。他低头看着自己的掌心，然后慢慢合拢了手指，把它收进了袖口里。窗外夜色正在持续地变深，像是被一层正在缓慢落下的帷幕盖住了所有的细节。塔底最后一丝脚步声已经被风声完全覆盖了。大长老坐在灯下没有动。
室女宗主星的夜比天圣那边沉。天圣的夜空里星尘颗粒很多，光从恒星的方向穿过那些悬浮的粉尘之后会被散射成一层持续流动的暗红色薄纱，像一枚正在被风吹动的旗帜正在不断地翻卷它的边缘。而室女宗主星的夜空是空旷的，像一面被反复擦过的深色镜面，星光从远处直接落下来，没有中间层。天顶的星星排布细密而均匀，像一枚被钉在黑色绒布上的针尖阵列正在持续地散发它们的冷光。
张德华站在禁地外围的石壁阴影里。他已经站了将近一个时辰，位置在那座塔的东北方向约两里处——一片被灵能侵蚀过的黑色岩体后面。那面岩体表面粗糙，裂隙从底部延伸到顶部，像一张被撕开又拼合的旧地图。他的右手垂在身侧，手指微微张开，手背贴着岩石的边缘。岩石表面温度大约比空气低三到四度，凉意从他手背的皮肤渗进来，经过指节之间的缝隙，持续地沿着他的小臂向上传导。他感觉到了那种凉意，没有缩手。他用它来确认自己仍然在等待的状态中没有偏移。
他的目光锁着禁地的入口。入口是一面石门，表面光滑，没有雕纹。石门的高度大约是一丈多，宽度刚好能容两人并排通过。门缝边缘有一道细长的凹槽——那凹槽在夜光中泛着一层极淡的银灰色，像是被反复摩擦过太多次后留下的痕迹。凹槽的宽度大约一指，深度大约半指，弧线均匀，从石门顶部一直延伸到底部，像一枚被竖着切开的线槽。
张德华的呼吸被压得很低。每一次吸气之间的间隔比平时多了一息左右，呼气的过程更慢。他的肺叶在每次呼吸时被均匀地扩张和收缩，肋骨的内侧随着呼吸微微起伏。
石门周围没有守卫。大长老调开守卫的时间比预期早了大约一刻钟——他在天光还没完全暗下去的时候就做了那件事，通过一道传讯符把外围的两个巡逻小队调去了东侧约三里处处理一个子虚乌有的灵能波动信号。那两个小队离开之后，禁地外围就空了。石门内侧没有声音透出来。没有脚步声，没有呼吸声，只有那层均匀的冷寂从门缝中持续地散发出来。那层冷寂从门缝渗出来之后，沿着石门的边缘向下流淌，在地面上铺开一层肉眼几乎看不见的凉意。
张德华在子时三刻的时候动了。他从岩体阴影中走出来，脚步不急。步伐跨度一致，落地的力度稳定。他的靴底踩在砾石地面上发出极轻的声响——那种声响被夜风吸收了，短促而细微，像一枚正在被缓慢推过干燥木面的硬币正在发出它持续的摩擦声。他走过那道低洼处时，靴底的砾石被压下去又弹回原位，边缘的细小颗粒在他脚后重新聚拢。他走到石门前停住了。他的右手在石门表面约半寸处悬停了一下，然后他伸出手指，沿着那道凹槽的边缘轻轻滑过。凹槽的底部干燥，边缘光滑。他的手指停住了，指腹贴着凹槽的边缘，感受着那层持续散发出来的凉意，没有继续移动。他把手指收回来，然后他推了。不是推门板——是推门板左侧约一掌宽的位置，那里有一处凹陷。那处凹陷的深度正好是一指，边缘的弧度和他的掌心弧度吻合。他按下去的时候，那处凹陷的底部微微沉了一线。石门开始向内滑动。
石门打开的声音比他预想中沉。石门向内平移的过程中，与地面接触的边缘发出了一声持续的摩擦声——那种声音被压缩在石门的重量和地面石板的硬度之间，像一枚正在被反复拉过木面的砂纸正在持续地释放它的阻力。滑动过程持续了大约三息。然后门完全打开了。
石室内部的空气涌出来了。干燥的、带着矿物气息的冷空气，像一枚刚从深水中被取出的石头正在持续地释放它内部储存的凉意。张德华吸了一口那层空气进入肺叶，感觉到的是一种持续而均匀的冷，没有潮气，没有异味，只有岩石本身被反复冷却后残余的气味——那种气味很淡，像一枚被焐了太久的石头正在缓慢地释放它存储的余温。他跨过门槛，走了进去。
石室比他预想中深。从门口到石室中央的距离大约六七步，但每一步走过去，温度都在持续地下降。他走到第三步的时候，左肩处接触到的那层空气已经比入口处低了大约一两度。他在第六步的时候停下来。
石室中央的地面上有一个蒲团。蒲团的边缘已经被坐出了明显的凹陷，深度大约一指，像是被反复的体重压过太多次后形成的稳定塌陷。蒲团上面坐着一个人。那人盘膝坐着，双手搭在膝盖上，掌心朝上。他的眼睛闭着，呼吸匀速而深。他的周身环绕着一圈正在缓慢运转的灵能光晕。光晕的颜色是暗蓝色的，亮度大约相当于一盏被调暗了一半的灯。光晕的转速不快，大约每三息完成一圈完整的旋转。
张德华站在那里，没有移动。他的目光落在那层正在缓慢旋转的光晕上，然后停住了。那层光晕的整体结构是均匀的，转速稳定，亮度分布没有明显的起伏。但在光晕的外缘——大约在距离那人身体约一尺的位置——有一处区域的亮度比其他区域暗了一些，大约暗了不到一成的程度。那处暗区的形状不规则，像一枚被磨损过的齿轮边缘正在持续地释放它残余的磨损痕迹。张德华站在第六步的位置上，看着那处暗区。他没有再往前走。
宗主睁开了眼。
从他眼睛睁开到灵能光晕的反应之间隔着大约半息——那半息里，他的瞳孔正在从闭眼后的散焦状态向聚焦状态过渡。然后他看到自己面前站着一个人。一个他不认识的人。他的身体在那一刻做出的第一个反应不是防御——是试图收拢正在运转的灵能循环。他的丹田处发出一声极轻的闷响，像一枚正在被突然合拢的盒盖正在撞击它的底座。那层正在运转的灵能光晕在那一瞬间剧烈波动了一下。暗蓝色的光芒从光晕的外缘向内收缩，然后向外膨胀，像一枚正在被突然压缩又释放的弹簧正在反复改变它的形状。功法反噬。
宗主没有防御的准备。他正在闭关，所有的灵能都在沿着固定的经脉路径循环，没有预留对外界冲击的缓冲通道。那层灵能光晕在收缩和膨胀的交替中开始出现裂纹——从最暗的那处区域开始，向两侧延伸，像一枚正在被压裂的瓷器表面正在从它的薄弱点向边缘扩散。裂纹的宽度一开始只有头发丝那么细，然后持续地扩展，扩展的速度不快，但每一步都在把原有的结构推向更深的崩解。
那层光晕在宗主身体周围持续了大约三息，然后碎了。
碎片从光晕的位置向外飞散，像被风吹散的细碎冰晶在空气中持续地旋转、坠落。每一片碎片的亮度都在落地的过程中逐渐变暗，像一枚正在被缓慢熄灭的灯芯正在释放它剩余的热量，直到完全消失。宗主的身体在光晕碎裂之后向前倾了大约半寸。他的右手按在地面上支撑住了自己。他的呼吸比刚才快了大约一倍，频率从每息一次变成了大约两息三次。
张德华的金光从他身后升起来了。那道光从肩胛骨下方的位置向上攀升，经过他的颈侧、耳后、头顶，凝聚成一尊完整的金色巨人。十丈。巨人站在石室中央，头顶几乎顶到石室的顶部。法相的右手抬起来了。拳头在最高点停了一息——像一面正在被确认位置的旗帜正在被固定——然后落下去。那一拳落在宗主身前的灵能光晕残片上，拳锋所及之处，残余的灵能碎片被完全粉碎，像一枚被碾碎的干果壳正在释放它最后的碎屑。宗主被那道冲击波推着向后滑了大约一丈，后背撞上石壁。他的身体沿着石壁滑落，单膝跪地，一只手撑着地面。
张德华站在石室中央，十丈法相站在他身后。他没有往前走，也没有收回法相。他的声音从那道金光前方传过来，不高，尾音落得平："宗主，你败了。"

宗主跪在石壁前，那层灵能碎片已经全部消散了。他的右手掌根按在地面上，指尖微微张开着，能看见指节处的皮肤正在泛着一层淡红色。他的呼吸持续地急促着，但他在撑住身体之后的那一瞬间咽了一下——那是一个吞咽的动作，他的喉结上下滚动了两次，像是把某件已经涌到喉咙口的东西重新压了回去。他抬起头来。他的目光从地面移到张德华的脸，移动的过程不快，中间隔着大约两息，然后他的目光落定了，停在那里。他的声音从正在平稳下来的呼吸中传出来，尾音比平时低了半度，正在被压平边缘——像一枚正在被缓慢冷却的金属片正在释放它剩余的热量："你是谁？"
"上国，张德华。"他把那五个字放在石室中央的地面上，放在已经碎裂的灵能光晕残片之间，放在正在缓慢沉降的粉尘上方。宗主的肩膀在听到那三个字之后松了一些——不是完全的放松，是那种"终于知道了自己面对的是什么人"之后的确认。他撑着地面站了起来。动作不快。先用右掌按压地面把自己推起来一半，然后左膝伸直，最后整个人站直了，动作的整个过程持续了大约五息。
他站在石壁前，看着张德华的方向。他的嘴角处出现了一线极细的红色，那线红色从他的下唇边缘开始，沿着下颌的走向向下延伸，停在了下颌与颈部的交界处。他没有抬手去擦。
"你是上国的人——"他开口了，声音比他刚站起来时低了一些，"大长老的调令是你——"他没有把话说完，最后一个词的尾音被他自己掐断了，像一根被剪断的线正在释放它被拉紧后的余颤。
张德华没有回答。他站在那里，十丈法相已经收回了大约一半的高度，但仍然站在他身后。石室内部的光正在缓慢地变化——从暗蓝色和金色交织的混合状态恢复到金色占主导的状态。墙面上那些正在缓慢恢复的灵能结晶已经重新开始发出微弱的光芒，从暗灰色过渡到浅蓝色。石室的地面上散落着那层灵能光晕碎裂后的残渣，细碎的颗粒在光线下反射出细密的光点，像一场极小的沙尘暴正在被日光从上方照透。
张德华转身朝石门的方向走。走了三步，他停下来，侧过头——不是完全转回身，只是侧了大约三分之一的角度："上国的条件已经送到了。大长老知道完整的条款。"
他没有等宗主的回应。他迈过了门槛，走进了门外的夜色。石门在他身后开始合拢，声音比打开时更轻——那层摩擦声被石门的重量压低了，闷闷的，像一面正在被缓慢合拢的厚书正在释放它最后的声音。那声音持续了大约三息，然后完全消失了。石室内重新恢复到只有灵能结晶持续发光的状态。光从墙壁上的结晶中洒落，在地面上形成一层持续流动的暗蓝色光纹。宗主站在石壁前，那层冷光从他正面照过来，把他下颌边缘那道正在缓慢凝固的血线照得分明。他抬起右手擦了一下嘴角，动作缓慢，指腹接触到那层凝固中的红色时停了一下，然后放了下来。
他低头看着自己的手，看着指腹上那层正在被体温缓慢融化的红色余痕。他在原地站了一会儿。远处石门已经完全合拢了。那层冷光仍然持续地从墙壁上洒落，在地面上铺开一层正在缓慢移动的光影。他沿着石壁慢慢坐了下来，后背靠着那面还残留着撞击余温的石壁，在地面上坐了很久。外面不知道什么时候起风了。风从石门边缘的缝隙渗进来，在他脚边打了一个旋，然后散进了石室深处。他仍然坐在那里，没有站起来。
那层被反噬冲击后经脉中残余的刺痛还没有完全消退，正在从他的丹田位置持续地、缓慢地向四周扩散。他把手放下来，垂在膝盖旁边，视线落在地面上那些正在缓慢沉落的灵能结晶碎片上。那些碎片在暗蓝色的光中持续地闪烁——像一面正在被风吹动的湖面正在释放它最后的余晖。

Recommended reading for all book friends: The National System of Immortal Cultivation Submitted to the National Text Chapter 072: The Maiden Sect Master’s Retreat Day (..la) The great elder sat under the lamp, his hand still open. The candle flame danced around him, lengthening his shadow on the wall by about an inch. He sat there, listening to the footsteps going down the steps step by step, getting lighter and farther away. The last footsteps disappeared at the bottom of the tower.
The wind outside the window came in from the direction of the Virgin Sect Master Star. The pen placed on the table was blown by the wind and stopped again. He looked down at his palm, then slowly closed his fingers and put it into his cuff. The night outside the window is continuing to get darker, as if a layer of curtain is slowly falling, covering all the details. The last trace of footsteps at the bottom of the tower was completely covered by the sound of wind. The great elder sat under the lamp and did not move.
The night of the Maiden Sect Leader Star is darker than that of the Heavenly Saint. There are many stardust particles in the heavenly night sky. After the light passes through the suspended dust from the direction of the star, it will be scattered into a layer of dark red gauze that continues to flow, like a flag being blown by the wind and constantly rolling its edges. The night sky of the Virgin Star is empty, like a dark mirror that has been rubbed repeatedly. The starlight falls directly from a distance without an intermediate layer. The stars on the zenith are arranged densely and evenly, like a pinpoint array nailed to black velvet, continuously emitting their cold light.
Zhang Dehua stood in the shadow of the stone wall outside the forbidden area. He had been standing for nearly an hour, about two miles northeast of the tower—behind a black rock mass eroded by psychic energy. The surface of that rock mass is rough, with cracks extending from bottom to top, like an old map that has been torn apart and put back together. His right hand hung by his side, his fingers slightly spread, and the back of his hand pressed against the edge of the rock. The surface temperature of the rock was about three to four degrees lower than the air. The coolness seeped from the skin on the back of his hand, passed through the gaps between his knuckles, and continued to travel up his forearm. He felt the coolness and didn't flinch. He used it to confirm that he was still in the waiting state without drifting.
His eyes were locked on the entrance to the forbidden area. The entrance is a stone door with a smooth surface and no carvings. The height of the stone gate is about ten feet, and its width is just enough for two people to pass side by side. There is a slender groove on the edge of the door seam - the groove glows with a very light silvery gray in the night light, like a mark left after being rubbed repeatedly too many times. The groove is about one finger wide and half a finger deep, with a uniform arc that extends from the top to the bottom of the stone door, like a vertically cut wire trough.
Zhang Dehua's breathing was suppressed. The interval between each inhalation is about a breath longer than usual, and the exhalation process is slower. The lobes of his lungs expanded and contracted evenly with each breath, and the insides of his ribs rose and fell slightly with each breath.
There are no guards around the stone gate. The Great Elder mobilized the guards about a quarter of an hour earlier than expected - he did it before the light had completely dimmed, and used a communication talisman to mobilize the two patrol teams on the outside about three miles to the east to deal with a non-existent psychic wave signal. After the two teams left, the perimeter of the forbidden area became empty. No sound came out from inside the stone door. There was no sound of footsteps or breathing, only the even layer of cold silence continued to emanate from the crack in the door. After that layer of coldness seeped out from the crack in the door, it flowed down along the edge of the stone door, spreading a layer of coolness on the ground that was almost invisible to the naked eye.
Zhang Dehua moved at three o'clock in the morning. He walked out from the shadow of the rock mass, his steps unhurried. The stride span is consistent and the landing force is stable. The soles of his boots made a very light sound when they stepped on the gravel ground - the sound was absorbed by the night wind, short and subtle, like a coin being slowly pushed across a dry wooden surface and making its continuous sound.Scratching sound. As he walked over the depression, the gravel on the soles of his boots was pressed down and bounced back into place, and the tiny particles on the edges gathered again behind his feet. He walked to the stone door and stopped. His right hand hovered about half an inch on the surface of the stone door, then he stretched out his fingers and gently slid along the edge of the groove. The bottom of the groove is dry and the edges are smooth. His fingers stopped, his fingertips pressed against the edge of the groove, feeling the coolness that continued to emanate, and he did not move any further. He pulled his fingers back, and then he pushed. It's not the sliding door panel - it's about a hand's width away from the left side of the sliding door panel, and there's a depression there. The depth of the depression was exactly one finger, and the curvature of the edge matched the curvature of his palm. When he pressed it down, the bottom of the depression sank slightly. The stone door began to slide inwards.
The sound of the stone door opening was deeper than he expected. As the stone door moved inwards, the edge in contact with the ground made a continuous friction sound - that sound was compressed between the weight of the stone door and the hardness of the stone slabs on the ground, like a piece of sandpaper being repeatedly pulled across the wooden surface and continuously releasing its resistance. The sliding process lasted about three breaths. Then the door opened completely.
The air inside the stone chamber surged out. The dry, mineral-flavored cold air is like a stone that has just been taken out of deep water and is continuously releasing the coolness stored inside it. Zhang Dehua took a breath of that layer of air and entered his lungs. What he felt was a continuous and even coldness. There was no moisture or odor, only the residual smell after the rock itself had been repeatedly cooled. The smell was very light, like a stone that had been baked for too long and was slowly releasing the remaining warmth it stored. He crossed the threshold and entered.
The stone chamber was deeper than he expected. The distance from the door to the center of the stone chamber is about six or seven steps, but with every step, the temperature continues to drop. When he took the third step, the layer of air that his left shoulder came into contact with was already about one or two degrees lower than the entrance. He stopped at the sixth step.
There is a futon on the ground in the center of the stone room. There was a clear depression on the edge of the futon, about one finger deep, like a stable collapse formed after being pressed by repeated weight too many times. There is a person sitting on the futon. The man was sitting cross-legged, with his hands on his knees, palms facing up. His eyes were closed and his breathing was steady and deep. He was surrounded by a slowly rotating spiritual halo. The halo is dark blue in color and about as bright as a half-dimmed lamp. The rotation speed of the halo is not very fast, completing a complete rotation approximately every three breaths.
Zhang Dehua stood there without moving. His eyes fell on the slowly rotating halo, and then stopped. The overall structure of the halo is uniform, the rotation speed is stable, and the brightness distribution has no obvious fluctuations. But at the outer edge of the halo - about a foot away from the man's body - there was an area that was a little darker than other areas, about less than 10% darker. The shape of the dark area is irregular, like the edge of a worn gear that is continuously releasing its remaining traces of wear. Zhang Dehua stood at the sixth step and looked at the dark area. He went no further.
The sect leader opened his eyes.
There was about half a breath between the opening of his eyes and the reaction of the psychic halo - during that half breath, his pupils were transitioning from the defocused state to the focused state after closing his eyes. Then he saw a man standing in front of him. Someone he didn't know. His body's first reaction at that moment was not to defend itself - it was to try to close in the running psychic circuit. There was a very light muffled sound from his Dantian, like a box lid being suddenly closed and hitting its base. The functioning spiritual energy halo fluctuated violently at that moment. Dark blue light shrinks inward from the outer edge of the halo, then expands outward, like a spring that is being suddenly compressed and released, changing its shape repeatedly. The skill backfired.
The sect leader was unprepared for defense. He was in retreat, and all spiritual energy was circulating along fixed meridians, with no buffer channels reserved for impact from the outside world. The layer of psychic halo began to appear cracks in the alternation of contraction and expansion - starting from the darkest area and extending to both sides, like a cracked porcelain surface spreading from its weak point to the edge. The width of the crack was only as thin as a hair at first, and then continued to expand. The expansion speed was not fast, but every step pushed the original structure deeper into disintegration.
The halo lasted around the sect leader's body for about three breaths, and then shattered.
The fragments flew outward from the halo, like fine ice crystals blown away by the wind, continuing to rotate and fall in the air. The brightness of each fragment gradually dims as it falls to the ground, like a slowly extinguished wick releasing its remaining heat until it disappears completely. The sect leader's body leaned forward about half an inch after the halo shattered. He pressed his right hand to the ground to support himself. His breathing was about twice as fast as before, and the frequency changed from one breath per breath to about two breaths and three breaths.
Zhang Dehua's golden light rose from behind him. That ray of light climbed upward from the position below his shoulder blades, passing through the side of his neck, behind his ears, and on top of his head, condensing into a complete golden giant. Ten feet. The giant stood in the center of the stone chamber, his head almost touching the top of the stone chamber. The Dharma Prime Minister's right hand was raised. The fist paused for a moment at the highest point - like a flag being confirmed and fixed - and then fell. The punch landed on the fragments of the psychic halo in front of the sect leader. Wherever the punch touched, the remaining psychic fragments were completely shattered, like a crushed dried fruit shell releasing its last fragments. The sect leader was pushed back by the shock wave for about a foot, and his back hit the stone wall. His body slid down the stone wall and he knelt on one knee, supporting the ground with one hand.
Zhang Dehua stood in the center of the stone chamber, with the ten-foot-long Faxiang standing behind him. He did not move forward, nor did he take back the Dharma image. His voice came from in front of the golden light. It was not high-pitched and had a low tone at the end: "Sect Master, you have failed."
The sect master knelt in front of the stone wall, and the layer of spiritual energy fragments had all dissipated. The heel of his right hand was pressed on the ground, his fingertips were slightly open, and he could see that the skin at his knuckles was glowing with a light red color. His breathing continued to be rapid, but he swallowed the moment after holding himself up - it was a swallowing action, and his Adam's apple rolled up and down twice, as if he was pushing back something that had already surged into his throat. He looked up. His eyes moved from the ground to Zhang Dehua's face. The movement was not fast, with about two breaths in between. Then his eyes settled and stopped there. His voice came out from his breathing that was calming down, and the tail tone was half a degree lower than usual, and was being flattened at the edge - like a piece of metal being slowly cooled and releasing its remaining heat: "Who are you?"
"Shangguo, Zhang Dehua." He placed those five words on the ground in the center of the stone chamber, between the fragments of the broken psychic halo, and above the slowly settling dust. The sect leader's shoulders relaxed a little after hearing those three words - not completely relaxed, but the kind of confirmation that "finally knows who he is facing." He stood up with his hands on the ground. Not moving quickly. First press the ground with your right palm to push yourself up halfway, then straighten your left knee, and finally stand up straight. The entire action lasts for about five breaths.
He stood in front of the stone wall and looked in the direction of Zhang Dehua. A very thin line of red appeared at the corner of his mouth. The line of red started from the edge of his lower lip, extended downward along the direction of the mandible, and stopped at the junction of the mandible and the neck.He didn't raise his hand to wipe it.
"You are from Shangguo——" he started, his voice was lower than when he first stood up, "The Great Elder's order is you——" He did not finish the sentence, the last sound of the last word was cut off by himself, like a cut thread releasing the lingering tremor after being tightened.
Zhang Dehua did not answer. He stood there, the Shizhang Faxiang had retracted about half of its height, but still stood behind him. The light inside the stone chamber is slowly changing - from a mixed state of dark blue and gold to a state where gold dominates. The slowly recovering psychic crystals on the wall have begun to glow faintly again, transitioning from dark gray to light blue. The floor of the stone chamber is littered with the fragmented remnants of the psychic halo. The fine particles reflect tiny spots of light under the light, like a tiny sandstorm being illuminated by sunlight from above.
Zhang Dehua turned and walked in the direction of Shimen. After taking three steps, he stopped and turned his head - not completely, but only about a third of the way: "The conditions of Shangguo have been delivered. The great elder knows the complete terms."
He did not wait for the sect master's response. He crossed the threshold and walked into the night outside. The stone door began to close behind him, and the sound was lighter than when it opened. The friction sound was muffled by the weight of the stone door, and it was muffled, like a thick book being slowly closed and releasing its last sound. The sound lasted for about three breaths and then disappeared completely. The stone room returned to a state where only the psychic crystals continued to glow. Light falls from the crystals on the wall, forming a continuous flowing dark blue light pattern on the ground. The sect leader stood in front of the stone wall, and the cold light shone from his front, clearly illuminating the slowly solidifying line of blood on the edge of his jaw. He raised his right hand and wiped the corner of his mouth slowly. When his fingertips came into contact with the solidified red layer, he paused and then put it down.
He looked down at his hands, looking at the red traces on his fingertips that were slowly melting away from his body temperature. He stood there for a moment. The stone gate in the distance has been completely closed. That layer of cold light continued to shine from the wall, spreading a layer of slowly moving light and shadow on the ground. He slowly sat down along the stone wall, leaning his back against the stone wall that was still warm from the impact, and sat on the ground for a long time. I don’t know when the wind started to blow outside. The wind seeped in through the gaps on the edge of the stone door, swirled around his feet, and then dispersed into the depths of the stone chamber. He was still sitting there, not standing up.
The residual sting in his meridians after the backlash has not completely subsided, and is continuously and slowly spreading from his Dantian to the surrounding areas. He put his hands down and hung them beside his knees, his eyes falling on the slowly sinking fragments of psychic crystals on the ground. Those fragments continued to flicker in the dark blue light - like a lake being blown by the wind and releasing its last afterglow.
